target.statement: Mean LSCV score of the Beta Reference Rule on 'nice' distributions (mean -2.2667, median -1.9134)

compute.basis: Target requires re-running the full Monte Carlo (8 distributions x 6 sample sizes x 1000 trials, plus LSCV/ISE baselines) which is CPU-bound but heavy; the reproduce-paper repo may supply configs, but the exact aggregation into Table 1 must be rebuilt.

blockers: Table 1 aggregates over many distributions/sample sizes and requires re-implementing the full simulation harness and LSCV/ISE baselines
